rename.reason: A named ref target is a primary-name resource usage, so rename updates the primary declaration plus every ordinary and named-ref `focus-ring` usage atomically while preserving the separately authored `focus` alias.
rename.note: NEW 2026-07-13. Representative LSP projection of same-node named-ref resource identity and the resource-ref-target edit kind.

references.reason: References include the custom-attribute primary and alias declarations plus every ordinary, alias, and named-ref usage with exact token spans.
references.note: NEW 2026-07-13; strengthened 2026-08-03. Confirms the IDE spends resource identity, including every authored public-name declaration, instead of rescanning attribute spelling.

hover.reason: Hover identifies the same-node ref target as the FocusRing custom attribute rather than describing the ref command generically.
hover.note: NEW 2026-07-13. Cursor dispatch spends the resolved named-ref controller definition.

hover.reason: Listener hover projects keydown through the DOM event map as KeyboardEvent.
hover.note: NEW 2026-07-13. Representative event-family TypeChecker projection at the IDE boundary.

hover.reason: Hover leads with the exact bare custom-attribute alias and keeps its canonical resource name and source-backed implementation as subordinate context.
hover.note: B2 non-tag alias witness: exact attribute-source ownership must outrank the unrelated default bindable carrier and its suppressed type uncertainty.

definition.reason: Definition navigates from the named ref target to the source-backed custom-attribute implementation class.
definition.note: NEW 2026-07-13. Representative navigation projection for named refs.

documentHighlight.reason: Document highlights include the ordinary primary usage, both same-file named ref targets, and the bare alias because all four resolve to one resource identity.
documentHighlight.note: NEW 2026-07-13. Highlights inherit the shared resource-reference context.
